name: shop/place-and-verify
description: Click Place Order, then assert status=found. The tight-timeout variant's /verify/:id endpoint returns 503 when the SDK's socketTimeout is too low for baseline upstream latency — every slow-tail DDB call trips the client-side timeout even though kumo would have responded. This is the journey-level catch for the client-side-misconfig pattern (#119 Gap 4) that POST /orders alone shows as ambiguous '5xx but why'.
